web.description: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday. web.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
web.description: Details have emerged about a new zero-day vulnerability in Cacti , an open-source network monitoring tool, that could be exploited to achieve remote code execution.   The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit, which has yet to be assigned a CVE identifier, has been tracked as 4HTTP2SHELL  and 4HTTP2ROOT .   "I found a path from a fresh, unauthenticated HTTP session to command execution as the Cacti server user in four requests," a security researcher who goes by the online alias "ek0ms savi0r" said . "No login. No valid API key. No phishing. Just four HTTP requests against the default guest surface."   The shortcoming affects Cacti Core 1.2.31, the latest version , on an isolated host when the guest account is enabled. web.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware
web.description: The threat actors behind the PolinRider  campaign have been observed planting a Python loader in GitHub repositories, as evidence emerges that the activity may have started as far back as February 2025.   "The loader hides in a small utils package or in conftest.py," SafeDep said  in a report published this week. "When Python imports the file, the loader reads the newest transaction that an Ethereum wallet sent to itself. It decodes the input data of that transaction as JavaScript and runs it with Node.js."
